title: SEC Company Financials (XBRL)
description: Annual or quarterly financials for any US-listed company from SEC XBRL data: revenue, gross profit, operating and net income, diluted EPS, assets, liabilities, equity, cash, operating cash flow, capex, long-term debt and shares.
eventDescription: One company fiscal period of financials
why: Numbers as the company tagged them in its own 10-K/10-Q, one row per period, no scraping of finance portals.
useCases: Analysts and AI agents building comps and screens
Lenders checking a borrower's reported financials
limits: Quarterly rows cover discrete quarters reported on 10-Q; Q4 is in the annual figure.
Companies that use non-standard tags may leave a metric blank.
